verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs explicitly document an automatic-solving stance for CAPTCHAs, naming specific supported types (reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Turnstile, FunCaptcha, MTCaptcha, text/number captchas), giving automation engineers a clear stance rather than silent failure. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that captcha solving actually works in practice, and no documented fallback behavior for unsupported captcha types.
